subject: Post-call follow-up: Orbit Analytics security discovery & roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Patel <amir@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call follow-up: Orbit Analytics security discovery & roadmap

Hi Amir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

Summary of what we covered:
- Scope: Orbit is evaluating Redwood for inference across analytics pipelines (customer data, PII).
- Immediate asks from your side: current SOC 2 status, GDPR controls, HIPAA posture (if applicable), and our completion of your vendor questionnaire.
- Commercial touchpoints: procurement will want standard terms and an indemnity/data processing addendum.

Ask / next steps:
1) Could you please send your vendor security questionnaire (we can fill it) — I believe you mentioned an XLSX template.
2) If possible, share the most recent SOC 2 report or SOC 2 summary (redacted if needed).
3) Confirm whether HIPAA is in-scope for Orbit’s workflows today (we noted healthcare customers in a couple of cases).
4) Suggest a 60-minute compliance deep-dive next week with Rishi (security lead) and Stephanie (privacy/product).

Target timeline:
- Amir: send questionnaire + procurement contact by EOD 02/26
- Redwood (Rishi): return completed questionnaire draft within 3 business days of receipt
- Schedule deep-dive for the week of 03/02

I’ve attached a one-page SOC2 summary we typically share for early diligence. I’ll own coordination with procurement once we have the questionnaire.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Attaching the vendor questionnaire we use (XLSX) and a procurement one-pager with billing/PO info. A few quick notes:
- SOC 2: Orbit requires potential vendors to provide SOC 2 Type II reports where available. Please send the SOC 2 summary you attached and we can follow up if we need the full report with an NDA.

- HIPAA: not currently in scope for Orbit’s primary analytics pipelines, but some customers route PHI through partner integrations — we want to understand boundaries.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Orbit compliance roadmap proposal (SOC scope & certification asks)

Internal note for planning before the deep-dive:

Context:
- Orbit is diligenceing Redwood for inference on customer data that includes PII. They want our questionnaire completed and a SOC2 artifact. They also want clarity on GDPR and the potential HIPAA boundary.

Proposal (high-level):
1) Quickly return Orbit’s questionnaire with references to our existing SOC 2 Type II coverage (2024), our DPA, and key subprocessors. Mark any items that would require evidence (pen tests, architecture diagrams, network segmentation docs).
2) For medium-term (Q2–Q3): recommend we propose a scoped SOC2 expansion to explicitly include inference endpoints and S3 buckets used for transient KV cache, to reduce back-and-forth for customers in regulated verticals. Impact assessment: ~3–6 weeks of security engineering time + audit scheduling.
3) For roadmap discussion with Orbit: surface ISO 27001 and FedRAMP ambitions as "in-progress" items; don’t over-promise timelines but show we have a plan. FedRAMP is a longer lift and only necessary if Orbit ultimately needs an authorized cloud service.

Immediate asks for you both before 03/02 questionnaire deadline:
- Rishi: assemble evidence references (SOC sections, control owners, standard artifacts). I’ll draft the questionnaire answers and send for your technical sign-off.
- Stephanie: prepare short DPA talking points and privacy boundary notes (GDPR processor vs controller, data minimization guidance).

I’ll propose meeting blocks to Orbit for 03/03 and 03/04; flag any conflicts.

Marissa

From: Amir Patel <amir@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: Orbit Analytics security discovery & roadmap

Marissa / team — appreciate the plan. A couple quick confirms:
- Redacted SOC2 summary is fine to start; if we need the full report we’ll sign an NDA.
- 03/03 at 10:00am PT works for me for the 60-minute deep-dive (please send invite).
- For the questionnaire, procurement would like the completed draft by 03/04 to align with their sourcing timeline.

I’ll be on the call and will loop Lina from procurement if there are contractual asks. Looking forward to the discussion — we’re especially interested in your roadmap for SOC scope expansion and whether ISO 27001 or FedRAMP are in the product plan.

Best,
Amir
Head of Security, Orbit Analytics
